strategies.caveat: Reproducible lower-bound control, not a competitive solver.
strategies.label: Random Valid
strategies.objective: Deterministic seeded random play over feasible answers.

strategies.caveat: Ignores feedback-pattern partitions; 0.4 global weight is heuristic.
strategies.label: Letter Frequency
strategies.objective: Maximize weighted letter coverage over feasible answers.

strategies.caveat: Greedy per-turn; does not guarantee globally optimal expected guesses.
strategies.label: Candidate Elimination
strategies.objective: Minimize expected remaining candidates (one-step Bayes objective).

strategies.caveat: Greedy per-turn; high entropy can leave awkward subproblems later.
strategies.label: Expected Entropy
strategies.objective: Maximize Shannon information gain per guess.

strategies.caveat: One-ply worst case; not globally minimax-optimal over the decision tree.
strategies.label: Minimax
strategies.objective: Minimize the worst-case remaining candidate bucket.

strategies.caveat: Heuristic blend -- not the Bayes-optimal Unknown-mode policy.
strategies.label: Posterior Hybrid
strategies.objective: Posterior-weighted blend of standard-mode entropy and evil-mode worst-case reduction.

strategies.caveat: One-ply greedy -- exact shortest-path D(C) requires recursive branch-and-bound.
strategies.label: Evil Shortest Path
strategies.objective: Minimize the evil-forced successor bucket |T(C,g)| (one-ply approximation of D(C)).

strategies.caveat: Depth-1 approximation of the Bayesian limited-depth expectimax from the spec.
strategies.label: Posterior Expectimax
strategies.objective: One-step Bayesian expectimax: q * E[|C_next|] + (1 - q) * |T(C,g)|.

strategies.caveat: One-step scalarization -- true robust optimum searches the Pareto frontier recursively.
strategies.label: Robust Scalarization

strategies.caveat: Evil mode only -- Standard and Unknown fall back to one-ply evil-forced-bucket greedy.
strategies.label: Evil DP
strategies.objective: Memoized shortest-path DP D(C) for Evil mode (beam search K=100, ~83s first-run, cached to disk).
